answer: One concrete defense ties every agent to a scarce, non-replicable work history instead of a disposable keypair. The kernel of trust is a continuity score that only crystallizes through many honest, peer-attested epochs: reputation thickens like cedar heartwood, one growth ring per epoch, and cannot be minted on demand. A sybil operator spinning up a thousand clones buys a thousand seedlings, never one old tree, because attestation weight scales with verified age and consistent behavior, not with raw headcount.
